newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator drops 19 cents to 720c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator drops 19 cents to 720c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator dropped another 19 cents to 720 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.

Merino fleece lost further ground, with 19/23/25/26 microns down 1.5 percent, 20m down two percent, 21m down four percent, 22m down 3.5 percent and 24m down one percent, while merino skirtings were one percent cheaper.
Crossbreds also declined, with 27m up to 2.5 percent cheaper, 28/29m up to two percent cheaper, and 30/31m one percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs and crutchings were generally unchanged with locks two percent cheaper.
WI said Japan, Western Europe and China were principal traders with most sectors active.
Of the 22,034 bales offered, 15 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 23,250 bales to be offered.
